 }
 
+// addMethodAllowed adds a method type to the allowed methods, keeping the
+// list sorted and without duplicates.
+func (x *Context) addMethodAllowed(mt methodTyp) {
+	i := 0
+	for i < len(x.methodsAllowed) && x.methodsAllowed[i] < mt {
+		i++
+	}
+	if i < len(x.methodsAllowed) && x.methodsAllowed[i] == mt {
+		return
+	}
+	x.methodsAllowed = append(x.methodsAllowed, 0)
+	copy(x.methodsAllowed[i+1:], x.methodsAllowed[i:])
+	x.methodsAllowed[i] = mt
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/cors.go
@@ -0,0 +1,270 @@
+package chi
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+// CORSOptions configures the Cross-Origin Resource Sharing headers written
+// by CORS and by Mux#EnableCORSWithOptions.
+//
+// A zero AllowOrigin, an empty AllowHeaders and a zero MaxAge stand for the
+// values of DefaultCORSOptions, so a partly filled struct stays usable. A
+// negative MaxAge leaves Access-Control-Max-Age out of the response.
+type CORSOptions struct {
+	// AllowOrigin is the value of Access-Control-Allow-Origin, "*" by default.
+	AllowOrigin string
+
+	// AllowMethods is the value of Access-Control-Allow-Methods. When empty,
+	// the methods the requested resource has handlers for are used instead.
+	AllowMethods []string
+
+	// AllowHeaders is the value of Access-Control-Allow-Headers.
+	AllowHeaders []string
+
+	// ExposeHeaders is the value of Access-Control-Expose-Headers. Nothing
+	// is exposed when it is empty.
+	ExposeHeaders []string
+
+	// MaxAge is how many seconds a browser may cache a preflight answer.
+	MaxAge int
+
+	// AllowCredentials sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials to true.
+	AllowCredentials bool
+}
+
+// DefaultCORSOptions returns the options Mux#EnableCORS uses: any origin, the
+// headers most APIs are called with, and a preflight cache of one hour. The
+// allowed methods are left empty so that they follow each resource's routes.
+func DefaultCORSOptions() CORSOptions {
+	return CORSOptions{
+		AllowOrigin:  "*",
+		AllowHeaders: []string{"Accept", "Authorization", "Content-Type", "X-CSRF-Token"},
+		MaxAge:       3600,
+	}
+}
+
+// methodNames maps a method type to its HTTP method name. It is the same map
+// as reverseMethodMap, so methods added by RegisterMethod are found in it.
+var methodNames = reverseMethodMap
+
+// GetMethodName returns the HTTP method name of a method type, such as "GET"
+// for mGET, or an empty string when the type is not a single known method.
+func GetMethodName(method methodTyp) string {
+	return methodNames[method]
+}
+
+// corsFallbackMethods are advertised for a path that no route matches, where
+// there is no resource to ask for its methods.
+var corsFallbackMethods = []string{
+	http.MethodGet, http.MethodHead, http.MethodPost, http.MethodPut,
+	http.MethodPatch, http.MethodDelete, http.MethodOptions,
+}
+
+// CORS returns a middleware that adds Cross-Origin Resource Sharing headers
+// to every response and answers OPTIONS requests itself as preflights, with
+// status 204 and the allowed methods, headers and max age. Without options it
+// uses DefaultCORSOptions.
+func CORS(options ...CORSOptions) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
+	opts := DefaultCORSOptions()
+	if len(options) > 0 {
+		opts = options[0].withDefaults()
+	}
+
+	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
+		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+			setCORSHeaders(w, r, opts)
+			if r.Method != http.MethodOptions {
+				next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+				return
+			}
+			setPreflightHeaders(w, r, opts)
+			w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+// withDefaults fills the fields that have no useful zero value.
+func (o CORSOptions) withDefaults() CORSOptions {
+	d := DefaultCORSOptions()
+	if o.AllowOrigin == "" {
+		o.AllowOrigin = d.AllowOrigin
+	}
+	if len(o.AllowHeaders) == 0 {
+		o.AllowHeaders = d.AllowHeaders
+	}
+	if o.MaxAge == 0 {
+		o.MaxAge = d.MaxAge
+	}
+	return o
+}
